title: Resolve merged branch pending snapshots
summary: Pending snapshot detection now treats snapshots and skips from merged branches as resolved ancestors of trunk, and only reports remaining non-merge product commits outside .eve as pending work.
userVisibleChange: The Pending Snapshot banner no longer appears on main for work that was already covered by snapshots or skips on merged feature branches.

risks.title: Merge conflict resolutions committed only in the merge commit may not trigger pending work
risks.mitigation: The new behavior matches the common PR merge false-positive and remains covered for unsnapshotted feature commits; conflict-only merge changes can be addressed with a more detailed merge-diff detector if needed.

timeline.title: Added merged branch regression
timeline.summary: Covered a feature branch product change that completes a snapshot, commits the EVE record, merges back to trunk, and expects no pending banner state.

timeline.title: Updated pending resolution
timeline.summary: Snapshot and skip candidates now use ancestor checks across branches, while pending ranges count only unresolved product commits.

timeline.title: Ran Go tests
timeline.summary: Focused pending snapshot tests and the full Go test suite passed.

decisions.title: Use ancestry instead of exact branch equality for resolved candidates
decisions.rationale: Once a feature branch is merged, its snapshot or skip git state is part of trunk history and should resolve the corresponding product work on trunk.

decisions.title: Exclude merge and .eve-only commits from pending product work
decisions.rationale: A clean merge commit and the committed EVE record do not represent new unresolved product work after the feature branch snapshot has already captured the change.
